LED Search Light.en: High-power LED search light with long-range illumination. IP65 protection for outdoor use. Ideal for search and rescue, marine, and outdoor exploration.
LED Search Light.zh: 高功率 LED 探照灯，远距离照明。IP65 防护等级，适合户外使用。适用于搜救、航海及户外探险。

Industrial Parts.en: High-quality industrial-grade components manufactured to strict tolerances. Designed for reliability and long service life in demanding applications.
Industrial Parts.zh: 高品质工业级组件，严格公差制造。专为苛刻应用场景设计，可靠性高，使用寿命长。

LED Economy Work Light.en: The lamp head adopts an IP67 full protection rating design, and the back cover battery box adopts an IP65 protection design. The lamp can reliably work in harsh environments. This product has a beautiful appearance, is waterproof.
LED Economy Work Light.zh: 灯头采用 IP67 全防护等级设计，电池盒采用 IP65 防护设计。可在恶劣环境中可靠工作，外观精美，防水耐用。

LED Flash Light.en: Compact and durable LED flashlight with high brightness output. IP65 water-resistant design. Suitable for everyday carry, outdoor activities, and emergency use.
LED Flash Light.zh: 紧凑耐用的 LED 手电筒，高亮度输出。IP65 防水设计，适合日常携带、户外活动和应急使用。

LED Solar Panel Products.en: The lamp head adopts IP65 full protection level design and monocrystalline silicon solar panel. Exquisite craftsmanship in appearance and easy installation, the lamp can reliably work in various environments. Aluminum alloy shell.
LED Solar Panel Products.zh: 灯头采用 IP65 全防护等级设计，配备单晶硅太阳能面板。外观工艺精湛，安装便捷，可在各种环境下可靠工作。铝合金外壳。

LED Strip Light.en: Colorful light strip, designed with IP20 full protection level. Exquisite craftsmanship in appearance and easy installation, the lamp can reliably work in various environments. This product has a beautiful appearance, is waterproof.
LED Strip Light.zh: 多彩灯带，IP20 防护等级设计。外观工艺精湛，安装便捷，可在各种环境下可靠工作，外观精美，防水耐用。

Bicycle Accessories.en: USB fast charging, convenient switch, high gloss LED light Suitable for most bicycles, compact and exquisite, saving space Multiple modes can be switched, making nighttime cycling safer Wide range, life grade waterproof, rainproof, damp, do not soak in rain for a long time.
Bicycle Accessories.zh: USB 快充，开关便捷，高亮度 LED 光源。适用于大多数自行车，小巧精致，节省空间。多模式切换，夜间骑行更安全。生活级防水，防雨防潮，不宜长时间浸泡。

LED Motorcycle Light.en: The lamp head adopts an IP67 full protection rating design, and the back cover battery box adopts an IP65 protection design. The lamp can reliably work in harsh environments. This product has a beautiful appearance, is waterproof.
LED Motorcycle Light.zh: 灯头采用 IP67 全防护等级设计，电池盒采用 IP65 防护设计。可在恶劣环境中可靠工作，外观精美，防水性能优异。

LED Work Light.en: The lamp is powered by AC and IP 67 protected. CE and Rosh B approved. Can work in harsh environments.
LED Work Light.zh: 采用交流电供电，IP67 防护等级。通过 CE 和 RoHS 认证，可在恶劣环境中稳定工作。

LED Pen Light.en: Convenient switch, exquisite craftsmanship appearance Daily emergency essentials, home storage does not take up space Compact and easy to carry, waterproof for daily use, not suitable for long-term exposure to sunlight and rain Suitable for camping, workshops, emergency services, fishing, home use, general use, and other occasions.
LED Pen Light.zh: 开关便捷，工艺精湛。日常应急必备，居家收纳不占空间。小巧便携，日常生活防水，不宜长时间暴晒或淋雨。适用于露营、车间、应急服务、钓鱼、家庭及通用场景。

LED Tripod.en: Exquisite craftsmanship in appearance and easy to install bracket. Different sizes can be installed in different locations. Waterproof and anti-corrosion: Can be used in rainy or harsh environments. Can be used to attach magnetic objects, freeing up hands.
LED Tripod.zh: 外观工艺精湛，支架安装便捷。多种尺寸可安装于不同场景。防水防腐蚀，可在雨天或恶劣环境中使用。可吸附磁性物体，解放双手。

LED Rechargeable Work Light.en: IP67 lamp head & IP65 battery box ensure reliable performance in harsh environments. Built with a modular circuit and LG battery protection for longer lifespan. Features multi-level brightness and SOS red light mode. Ideal for camping, home power outages, roadside emergencies, and night use.
LED Rechargeable Work Light.zh: 灯头 IP67 级防护，电池盒 IP65 级防护，确保在恶劣环境下性能可靠。采用模块化电路和 LG 电池保护方案，使用寿命更长。具备多级亮度和 SOS 红光模式，适用于露营、家庭停电、路边紧急救援及夜间使用。

LED Head Light.en: Convenient switch, exquisite craftsmanship appearance Essential for fishing, with a wide range and free hands Compact and easy to carry, waterproof for daily use, not suitable for long-term exposure to sunlight and rain Suitable for camping, workshops, emergency services, fishing, home use, general use, and other occasions.
LED Head Light.zh: 开关便捷，工艺精湛。钓鱼必备，照射范围广，解放双手。小巧便携，日常生活防水，不宜长时间暴晒或淋雨。适用于露营、车间、应急服务、钓鱼、家庭及通用场景。

LED Light Bar.en: Suitable for different types of trucks, cars, and other vehicles. The exquisitely crafted appearance and easy to install bracket enable the lamp to work reliably in harsh environments. This product has a beautiful appearance, is waterproof.
LED Light Bar.zh: 适用于各类卡车、汽车等车辆。外观工艺精湛，安装支架便捷，可在恶劣环境下可靠工作，外观精美，防水耐用。
